comments: Auto-hiking crew controller for sail::CrewController. The crew is one point mass (mass.json) moved across the boat: toward the windward rail in proportion to heel above a threshold, to the centreline in light air and downwind, rate-limited so that crossing from rail to rail takes transit_time. Hull frame, y to port, z up, provisional frame of mass.json (hull_hydro.json transform maps it to the body frame). Rail y and z are built from the deck half-width at the crew station, the sheer height and the sitting height of mass.json; none of the numbers below measure how a J/80 crew actually moves.

deck_half_width_at_crew.method: largest |y| of the hull_visual.obj vertices within 0.15 m of the crew station x (mass.json crew_cg_x = -5.5 m provisional, -1.7129 m body frame), which lie on the deck edge at the sheer. The hull is 1.244 m at the maximum beam station, half the certificate beam 2.488 m.

rail_inset.method: the crew's centre of mass sits inboard of the deck edge by about half a hip width plus the lifeline stanchion line, when seated on the edge.

hiking_outboard.method: extra outboard travel of the crew's centre of mass when hiking, torso leaning over the lifeline, relative to sitting on the deck edge.

hiking_drop.method: lowering of the crew's centre of mass between sitting upright on the centreline (sheer plus mass.json crew_cg_above_sheer) and fully hiking, from leaning back and out.

heel_threshold.method: heel below which the crew stays on the centreline, so that normal motion does not move them.

heel_full.method: heel at which the crew is fully hiking. Between the threshold and this the target position is linear in heel.

light_air_aws.method: apparent wind speed, at the sail plan's centre of effort, below which the crew stays on the centreline. The target fades linearly across light_air_ramp centred on this speed.

light_air_ramp.method: width of the fade, so the target does not flip at a single wind speed.

downwind_awa.method: absolute apparent wind angle above which the crew stays on the centreline. The target fades linearly across downwind_ramp centred on this angle.

transit_time.method: time to cross from one hiking position to the other. The lateral speed limit is the distance between the two hiking positions divided by this.

hiking_posture_fraction.method: fraction of the full hiking offset the crew's position must reach for windage to treat the crew as hiking rather than sitting.

update_min_move.method: BoatSim::step_crew pushes a new crew position into the mass model and the running simulation only after it moves this far (or the posture changes), so a still crew costs nothing.
